Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** inside **Reproduce a game**. Saved names now return when progress loads.

Fixed imports that rejected valid saves with reordered JSON fields, while preserving existing save compatibility.

All code and test edits were delegated. Passed: 150 unit/static tests, 84 browser tests, typecheck, fresh builds, and changed-file formatting.

Remaining check limitations: repository formatting flags 23 unchanged files; Open Forge doctor fails internally with `ArgumentException`.
